paragraphs.text: Rice Patrol: a bounded reasoning loop guard and clean recovery plugin for DeepSeek Harness
# Rice Patrol 🍚🐋
中文
Rice Patrol protects reasoning streams in DeepSeek Harness (DSH). When sustained short-line repetiti
on is confirmed, it stops the current generation and resumes the unfinished task in the same convers
confirmed, it stops the current generation and resumes the unfinished task in the same conversation.
## One automatic recovery flow
Enable the plugin; no response-mode selection is needed. Every confirmed loop follows the same stop-
and-resume flow. There is no Stop / Observe / Recover selector, observation logger, or n-gram detect
-resume flow. There is no Stop / Observe / Recover selector, observation logger, or n-gram detector.
Legacy `mode: stop`, `mode: observe`, and `mode: recover` values no longer select behavior. They may
be removed, but leaving them in an old profile does not prevent automatic recovery. Use DSH's plugi
n enable/disable control to turn off Rice Patrol entirely.
The **Stop recovery** button remains available during recovery. New user input also interrupts the c
urrent recovery. Unverifiable session or background-job state pauses recovery with an explanation.
## Detection
The plugin reads reasoning text exposed by DSH, splits it into trimmed nonempty lines, and scores th
e last **50 lines**. A median line length of at most **20 characters**, with at least **70% of lines
** having an exact duplicate inside that window, produces a warning. After at least 50 additional no
nempty lines, another matching window confirms the loop and stops generation.
A warning alone does not stop output. The rule is provider-independent and uses a fresh detector for
each model request. An ordinary output-token limit is outside its scope. This update does not chang
e detection thresholds.
## Continuation
Rice Patrol waits for the stopped generation and stream cleanup, verifies host background jobs, excl
udes interrupted reasoning from model-visible history, and continues through the original Agent and
session. Completed file edits and tool results remain available. The continuation asks the model to
inspect workspace state before repeating side effects.
Each newly confirmed loop can recover; the same stop submits only one handoff. Failed or blocked old
recoveries do not restart themselves. The resumed Agent follows normal DSH policies, without an ext
ra summarization model request or plugin-imposed limits on later model/tool calls.
`resumeTimeoutMs` defaults to five minutes for handoff and the first resumed response, rather than t
he entire subsequent task. Minimal recovery status and deduplication records remain; there is no per
-chunk observation log.
## Enablement and configuration
The current package is `0.2.11-desktopcompat.1`. It requires DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` or newer (`0.2.1-rc.1`
included) and has no upper bound, so later 0.2.x releases load without a version exemption. The sou
rce is available on GitHub; this update does not publish an npm package.
DSH checks a plugin's declared requirements at load time and skips any plugin pinned to a different
exact version. Rice Patrol now declares `>=0.2.0-rc.2` for `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` and `@deepseek-ai/
dsh-compaction`, which is why it stays enabled across 0.2.x patch releases.
Enable Rice Patrol and its components on the Plugins page. The plugin page explains automatic recove
ry; recovery status appears near the conversation input. See config/recover.example.yml.
Provider/model filters, state directory, and recovery timeouts remain configurable. Response mode is
not configurable. Use only one controller that cancels and resumes a given reasoning stream.
Restart DSH after updating installed files to load the new host code. Historical implementation note
s are in docs/SINGLE_AGENT_RECOVERY.md. MIT license.
